errors.evidence: The time periods are shown on the vertical axis, not the horizontal axis. This is a horizontal bar chart.
The first period listed on the chart is '1990-1995', not '1996-1995'. The format '1996-1995' is also reversed and nonsensical.
The percentage values are shown on the horizontal axis, not the vertical axis.
The shortest bar in the chart corresponds to the period '1990-1995', not '1996-1995'.
The value for the shortest bar (period 1990-1995) is approximately 16%, not 12%.
The value for the highest bar (period 2013-2018) is approximately 29%, not 31%.

errors.text_span: Степента на запълване на стълбовете е еднаква във всички периоди.
errors.evidence: This phrase, which translates to 'The degree of filling of the bars is the same in all periods', is ambiguous and uninformative. The length (value) of the bars is clearly different, and stating that the color fill is the same is trivial.
